capabilities: Display image alt text as captions in reading view
Configure caption position above or below the image
Strip Obsidian size parameters from captions
Skip images with empty alt text
extras: The README mixes user documentation with developer instructions for building and releasing the plugin; no screenshots or usage examples are included, and the API documentation link is empty.
problem: Obsidian reading view discards image alt text, so captions written into the image markdown syntax are invisible to readers.
summary: Plugin that renders image alt text as visible captions above or below images in Obsidian's reading view.
